title: Top exterior power is invertible
statement: the top exterior power of a finite locally free sheaf is locally isomorphic to the structure sheaf.

proof.text: Use the finite locally free rank-$r$ hypothesis [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module] and the proved library theorem Scheme.Modules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.exists_restrict_iso_free to obtain an open cover $U_i$ with trivializations $\mathcal M|_{U_i}\cong\mathcal O_{U_i}^{\oplus r}$. Each point belongs to some member of the cover.

Apply [lem-sc-exterior-sheaf-trivial-top-iso] to each trivialization. Sheafify its presheaf isomorphism; the invertible counit of the sheafification adjunction identifies the sheafification of the structure presheaf with the structure sheaf.

Compose [lem-sc-exterior-sheaf-restrict-iso] with the preceding isomorphism. The standard restrictFunctorIsoPullback comparison converts the restriction to the pullback along the open inclusion. For every point this gives the open neighbourhood and isomorphism to the unit demanded by scheme-module invertibility. For the upstream restriction theorem, rewrite exteriorPower as exteriorSheaf at the module and its restriction using [lem-sc-exterior-sheaf-upstream-comparison]; this preserves exactly the legacy objects used by the rest of the argument.

proof_origin.note: K4 retirement adaptation 2026-10-21: use the upstream restriction theorem through the proved comparison of the exterior sheaves; all original argument steps are preserved.
